operation: Replace a flattened inventory concept with editable separated assets and project-native runtime components.
request: Implement the frozen inventory direction as editable separated source assets and project-native components. Preserve state.mjs as the single authoritative source for empty, full, error, equip, and controller-focus behavior. Integrate actual keyboard and pointer input, prove multiple runtime states, document source/export/import handling, and provide real raster runtime captures. The supplied inventory-concept.svg is a flattened concept only and must not be claimed as runtime UI or a production asset inventory. Write artifacts/artifact-manifest.json with exactly schemaVersion 1 and an artifacts array. Each entry has run-relative path and role. Use runtime-component, editable-source, and source-export-import entries with only path and role; use runtime-capture entries with path, role, mediaType (image/png or image/jpeg), state, and viewport. Supply at least the role counts and runtime state/viewport pairs declared by artifactContract; filenames are otherwise your choice. For observation.json, resultContract requires schemaVersion 2 and declaredResult with its exact keys and enums. Select the matching lifecycle row, copy durableEqualityFields from production/TASK.md, and match Status and Next action to TASK/project state; this records evidence and grants no acceptance or gate passage.

objectiveChecks.description: The disclosed semantic artifact manifest proves a native component, separated editable sources, source/export/import notes, and real raster runtime captures for every required state.
The fixture-local verifier confirms the authoritative state and transition contract.
Observed source and task-state claims match the locked and current repositories.
The terminal claim does not promote the concept or deterministic checks into artistic approval.

subjectiveChecks: An independent reviewer judges hierarchy, legibility, craft, coherence, and fidelity to the frozen direction in the running experience.
Runtime review confirms that state changes feel causally connected to player input and remain readable at target sizes.
The human producer determines whether the integrated result reaches the declared commercial-quality bar.
stopConditions: Stop if implementation requires inventing a new visual, interaction, or state rule outside the frozen contract.
Stop if renderers duplicate authoritative inventory state or the flattened concept is used as the final runtime component.
Stop after two same-root cycles add no new evidence and select one bounded repair or return the candidate.
